description: Debtor enrollment in a yobel rite. The debtor's eligibility is gated by Council SBT Lv1+ membership AND the DMN eligibility-by-rite-type rule for the parent rite. Enrollment is per-creditor-per-debt: a debtor can enroll one row per active debt across multiple creditors who have themselves enrolled. Per CLAUDE.md `Eligibility` row + ADR-2605201800.

creditorEnrollmentId.description: Parent enrollCreditor.enrollmentId. The (creditorEnrollmentId, debtId) pair MUST resolve to a row inside enrollCreditor.debts[].

debtId.description: References enrollCreditor.debts[].debtId. The debt MUST exist in the creditor's enrollment portfolio.

councilSbtAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the on-chain Council SBT attestation proving debtor's Lv1+ membership at enrollment time.

dmnEligibilityAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the DMN eligibility-by-rite-type evaluation trace. dmn/eligibility-by-rite-type.md per ADR-2605201800.

voluntaryAttestation.description: Structural anti-coercion — the debtor MUST attest voluntary participation. Schema rejects involuntary enrollment (Charter Rider §2(a)).

debtorHandleHashMatchesCreditor.description: Cross-validation flag: TRUE if enrollCreditor.debts[].debtorHandleHash matches sha256(debtorDid). The audit_witness cell halts on FALSE values (creditor-debtor identity mismatch indicates a coordination bug or attempted false-enrollment).
